bootedAt.description: Start of the current daemon boot; null until the first boot after 2026-10-01

complete.description: final=1 accepted, or filled from the bundle

truncated.description: Cut at FLEET_LOG_MAX_BYTES; the full text is in the bundle

legacySampled.description: The attempt has only sampled `log` timeline events (a v1/v2 runner)

offset.description: Byte offset of the line start

length.description: Bytes of the line, including its newline

unparsed.description: Run stream: the line is not a nax LogEntry

truncatedLine.description: The entry is a piece of a line (overlong, or read from mid-line)

text.description: The raw line without its newline (unparsed, stdout, stderr)

entries.description: Ascending by offset in both directions

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next request in the same direction

atEnd.description: Forward: no complete line after nextCursor. Backward: nextCursor is 0

medianJobCostUsd.description: Median per-job spend in the window (each job counts only its spend inside the window), 4 places; null with no jobs (D388)

key.description: Group key; `(none)` for an empty dimension; `other` when folded

label.description: repo owner/name, runner name, project slug, else the key

folded.description: True only for the series that folds every key beyond the top `top` (default 12)

ledgerCostUsd.description: Sum of ingested cost ledgers; null before ingest

pending.description: Ingest rows pending or running, of jobs finished in the window

failed.description: Ingest rows that failed after their retries

ingest.description: The latest attempt with an ingest row

corrected.description: The state was corrected from finish-audit (spec §3.2)

confirm.description: The project's slug, or ALL when no projectId is given

type.description: Project scope sees only offline and configuration

jobsHeld.description: offline: runner-held jobs of every project

version.description: stale_nax: this runner (global admin scope only)

latest.description: stale_nax: newest online core version (global admin scope only)

plugin.description: interaction: the plugin nax could not start (global admin scope only)

code.description: interaction: nax error code (global admin scope only)

profile.description: interaction: the profile; absent means the base config (global admin scope only)

running.description: ASSIGNED + RUNNING + UPLOADING jobs in scope (not capped)

naxVersion.description: Global admin scope only; null in project scope or when capabilities are unreadable

credentials.description: Global admin scope only; empty in project scope

storiesDone.description: Stories with status passed; null when unknown or truncated

since.description: When the condition started; null when unknown

generatedAt.description: Server time every age is measured against

recentJobs.description: Finished in the last 24 h, newest first, at most 20

readable.description: False when the stored capabilities do not parse; the runner then has no cells

action.description: Raw action code (e.g. CREATED, STATUS_CHANGE); the client words it

actorId.description: User or agent id of the actor

projectSlug.description: null when the project row is gone

pendingApprovals.description: Pending approvals counted across the scanned pending list

reason.description: failed = finished FAILED/ESCALATED/CRASHED within the window; blocked = waiting on a pending approval

tickets.description: Assigned to the caller, open, newest update first, capped

approvals.description: Pending in the caller's projects (plus no-project ones for a global admin), newest first, capped

jobs.description: Blocked first, then failed, both newest first, capped

attentionJobs.description: Recent failed jobs plus jobs waiting on a pending approval (7-day window)

generatedAt.description: Server time every age is measured against

projects.description: Attention first, then open tickets, then name

activity.description: Merged ticket/agent/decision events, newest first, capped

path.description: Empty string or slash-separated safe directory path
